Home.headerTitle: Discover our exclusive selection of Wines and Sparkling, carefully crafted for people's enjoyment
Home.titleDescription: First Champagne House in Northern Argentina.
Home.homeDescription: A family-run boutique winery, deeply in love with the Calchaquí Valley. Creator of the sparkling wine Burbujas de Altura, complemented by its diverse wine lines: Tinquiao, Vinland, Freya, Drakkar, and aged blends. Discover the secrets of our vineyards, how we craft our sparkling wines, and savor our wines with the personalized, family-friendly, and passionate wine tourism experience that defines us.
